```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("TBL.DEQ.PGA", inherits = FALSE)) stop("executive results: the caller must define TBL.DEQ.PGA, the id of the table it places.", call. = FALSE)
if (!exists("ExecutiveSummary", inherits = FALSE)) {
  source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "executiveResults.R"))
}
if (!exists("PSA_Units", inherits = FALSE)) PSA_Units <- "g"
Units <- .executiveUnits(PSA_Units)
SEP <- " to "
Standards <- knitr::combine_words(ExecutiveSummary$criteria$standards, and = " and ")
Bands <- ExecutiveSummary$criteria$bands
Sa <- function(v) .fmtSa(v, PSA_Units)
PGA.all <- .executiveRange(c(Bands$minimum, Bands$maximum), SEP, Sa)
```

- **Design Criteria for Tailings Storage Facilities.** Seismic design for tailings storage facilities is based on a two-level performance framework: the Operating Basis Earthquake (OBE), associated with continued operation, and the Safety Evaluation Earthquake (SEE), associated with preventing a tailings release [@ICOLD2016; @USACE1995]. The design earthquakes of the tailings storage facilities were evaluated under `r Standards`, for the consequence classes and the operation, closure, and post-closure lifecycle stages that each framework defines [@gistm2020; @cda2021; @ancold2019]. On reference rock, the design PGA ranges from `r PGA.all` `r Units` across frameworks, consequence classes, and lifecycle stages. Table [-@`r TBL.DEQ.PGA`] reports, by consequence class and site condition, the design PGA of the GISTM framework at the operation stage; the design-criteria chapter reports the design PGA and design spectra by framework, consequence class, lifecycle stage, and site condition.

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(list = intersect(c("SEP", "Units", "Standards", "Bands", "Sa", "PGA.all"), ls()))
```
